9:58
MBCC Operation Conference Room
You walk into the largest conference room in the MBCC and find staff from all allied departments already seated in there in a crowd.
In the front row, you notice a familiar figure talking with the Bureau's staff.
Noticing your arrival, she waves at you.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Good morning, Chief.
Having spent a week together, Moore is getting familiar with the people at the Bureau. Everyone finds this slightly clumsy yet amiable technician quite likable.
Having been fed and taken care of by everyone for the past few days, Moore is looking much more refreshed now than before.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Hehe, I know what you're thinking. Don't worry, I got three full hours of sleep last night.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: I even had four cups of coffee this morning. I'm full of energy now and ready to go anytime.
You glance at your device. It's exactly 10:00 now. The large conference room is already filled with people.
Right then, Nightingale also comes over to inform you that all the department heads are already there.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then let's begin.
You step onto the stage as Moore follows closely behind dragging her case. The large screen behind you turns on, displaying the subject of the meeting.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ladies and gentlemen, good morning. Welcome to the MBCC for this special meeting on the investigation of the dark web.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The purpose of this meeting is to mobilize and instruct all departments to participate in a series of upcoming operations targeting the dark web. But first, we need to have a clear understanding of the threat posed by the dark web.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: To this end, the MBCC has invited Moore, the technical expert from the Nirvana Cybersecurity Center, to give you a presentation.
Sparse applause rises from the audience. You step aside, and Moore takes the cue to come forward.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Ahem... Hmm, hello everyone, this is Moore.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: First, we need to understand the definition of the dark web.
Moore presses a button, and the slide on the screen behind her changes accordingly.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: The dark web we know, broadly speaking, is a series of websites using a special server framework. This can effectively block tracking and prevent official departments from directly accessing its user data.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Information leakage, human trafficking, illegal transactions, contract killing... The dark web has provided a strong cover for these crimes since N.F. 112. The West District and Eastside PSBs have been unable to trace it or even define it.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: It was only until the first half of this year, as the dark web became increasingly bold with its actions and with efforts of departments like the MBCC, that we finally identified the mechanism, or rather, the purpose, sustaining such a colossal entity as the dark web.
Moore pauses slightly.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Mania digitalization... A special technology that directly samples Mania and maps the jumbled data into information that can be understood by humans.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Nowadays, the dark web's data stream is a sea of dangerous information. Prolonged exposure can alter cognition, leading to mental fatigue and paranoia. In extreme cases, individuals may even suffer a mental breakdown and contract Mania.
Moore looks at you, and you take over seamlessly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The Gray Mirror Vote and Elysiland incidents have already wreaked significant damage in the first half year. And even so, the dark web hasn't yet reached its limit.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've already conducted some investigation on the dark web with Cybersec. And we've discovered that its scale and influence are far greater than we had previously estimated.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Given the nonprofit nature of the dark web, the mastermind behind must have an ulterior motive for sustaining such a costly framework.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We must act first and annihilate the dark web before it gets the chance to succeed in its scheme! This is exactly why everyone is gathered here today...
Hold on, I have a question.
In the audience, someone raises a hand and interrupts your speech.
I think everyone here is already aware of the facts you just presented. We're not blind. We've all seen what's happened in Eastside over the past months.

But now the MBCC, Cybersec, and even the Ring Research Institute have intervened. And in reality, the dark web hasn't made a new move over the past three months. I don't think it's tenable to claim that the dark web is planning something big based on mere speculation.

Moreover, civilian casualties and economic losses were perfectly manageable even in the previous incidents. Now that the dark web has been contained, what reason do we have to mobilize so many departments for an investigation on a few internet criminals of little significance?
Standing on the stage, you furrow your brow as you listen.
This is indeed a view popular among all the departments at present, which raises a thorny question. Without solid evidence to prove the dark web's next moves, it's hard to refute this argument.
As you're forming a response, you notice Moore next to you inputting a command into the computer, whereupon the questioner's personal info appears on the screen of the workstation immediately.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Simpson Ford, Deputy Chief of the Eastside Public Security Bureau, correct?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Your brother, former FAC Technical Supervisor Ed Ford, was involved in a laptop explosion incident. Did you know it was a revenge attack orchestrated by the dark web?
The Deputy Chief stands up urgently. However, Moore is unaffected by his reaction and continues.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Hmm? So you didn't know... I see. The investigation into the accidental deaths of public servants was only recently completed. That's why you haven't heard yet.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: The official notice and compensation will be issued this week... Congratulations, your brother didn't die in an accident but in the line of duty.

steps.speaker: Simpson
steps.content: You...!
The audience erupts in an uproar, drowning out Deputy Chief Simpson's furious shouts. Staff from all departments begin discussing as the terrifying truths become gradually clear to all.

You peer down from the stage. When the discussion quiets down, even the Deputy Chief who was the first to lose his temper has gone back to his seat with a broody expression. You know you've achieved your purpose.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now, we'll discuss the details of the operations against the dark web.
You look around, and no one raises any objections. Moore presses the button in time to go to the last slide.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've divided the action plan into three parts.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Part one: curb the spread of digitalized Mania.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This has already seen success under the collaboration of departments like the MBCC and Cybersec. The firewall constructed by Moore provides solid defense against attacks from the dark web and can trace peripheral threats.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: With this tracing function, we can proceed to part two of our plan.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All departments will endeavor to search for potential entities behind the dark web and capture everyone involved. Whether it's criminal individuals or organizations using the dark web, with thorough investigations, we can effectively undermine its very foundation.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Step three. During the Gray Mirror Vote incident in April, we obtained a crucial lead: The dark web has a physical main server. This has been confirmed by the tracking report provided by Moore. Therefore, the MBCC will set up a special task force.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Despite the technical difficulty in the defense against the dark web and the elusive nature of the culprit behind it, as long as we can find this server and destroy it, it'll no longer be a threat to us.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Therefore, to all department heads present, the MBCC requires your assistance. We hope everyone can actively cooperate with us so we can tackle the dark web together and eradicate this blight once and for all.
Your voice is resonant and powerful, echoing in the silent conference room.
Before long, you hear soft chatter in the venue. Even though there are still a few opposing voices, they can no longer overturn the majority.
And just like that, the action plan against the dark web is confirmed.

12:19
Outside the conference room
After the meeting, you and Moore leave the stage.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Phew, it's finally done. I'm exhausted. I feel like I can barely keep my eyes open...

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Chief, I'll head back to catch up on some sleep. See you... yawn... tomorrow...
You say goodbye to Moore and watch her turn around in wobbly steps. You take out your communication device from your pocket to check if you've missed any important messages during the meeting.
Strangely, the screen remains black. You keep tapping, yet there is no response.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Weird... Is something wrong with it? I made sure to charge it yesterday...
Before you even finish the sentence, Moore jolts and flings herself around.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Watch out! Drop it now!
A blood-red dot expands rapidly on the screen, turns into a black and red data stream instantly, and bursts out of the screen, aiming straight at your face.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Move!
As if by instinct, Moore lunges toward you.
At the same time, the data stream overflowing from the device screen gets blocked by several suddenly emerged walls formed by digits.
Zlack...!

The black and red data stream crashes into the firewall, making a piercing noise. It is then harshly compressed by the digital walls. Within a few seconds, the strange data stream, along with your device, is crushed into pieces.
All noise has quieted down, but Moore seems slow to react. Though it all appears to be over now, she still holds onto you tightly, hands gripping firmly and eyes shut. She seems terrified.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Eh? Ah!
Moore finally sees your face turning pale from having the oxygen squeezed out of you and quickly releases her grip.
She scoots back a bit awkwardly.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Ah... I forgot to install a firewall on your device. All that was a little unnecessary...

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Sorry, I tend to get clumsy when I'm tired...

options: Don't squeeze me so hard next time.

choices.text: Don't squeeze me so hard next time.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Hehe...
Moore glances at the debris on the floor.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Sorry I couldn't save your device...
Moore picks up the pieces of the device and hands them over regretfully.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: It's the dark web's doing. I hope your confidential files were not damaged...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: At least I'm safe. It's all thanks to your firewall.
You look at the charred pieces and recall the incident just now. It was a close call.
If it weren't for Moore's firewall, or had the attack targeted another investigator instead of you...
Would the person have already lost their life without knowing why, just like those victims Moore mentioned earlier?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Moore, check on the other investigators who attended the meeting. See if they also got attacked.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Huh? ...Okay!
Moore instantly boots up her workstation and hands you the answer in less than a minute.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: ...The others are fine. Maybe they're not that valuable to the dark web?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Good.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But we can't let our guard down yet. Send a notification to warn them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: By the way, Moore, can your firewall be installed on all of their devices too?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Sure. I'll send them the latest security system right away.
Moore says as her fingers already begin typing away on the keyboard.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Done.
Upon receiving the desired answer, you let out a long sigh of relief.
Moore looks up at you, then suddenly tilts her head a little curiously.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Aren't you scared?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hmm... Scared?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: You just got attacked by the dark web... Shouldn't you feel scared?
Indeed. This is already the fifth attack by the dark web in a week. Each one is more threatening and unpreventable than the last. You should feel scared.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: ...Facing such relentless attacks from the dark web, a normal person should feel scared and fear they may not be so lucky next time, but...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The fact that I was attacked and the people who tried to investigate it got killed proves that the dark web itself is not invincible. The more intense its reaction, the closer we are to the truth.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The dark web's attention is all on me now, which gives us a perfect opportunity.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Are you... planning to use yourself as bait?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Of course, I don't intend to sacrifice myself for this operation. That's why I need someone who can protect me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Someone with excellent technical competence, a partner I can trust wholeheartedly...
No matter how you look at it, Moore is the best candidate. She has protected you multiple times from attacks and is crucial aid in investigating the dark web.
You can even say that without Moore, the operation could never have gone this smoothly to this point.
But can you really trust her?
The intelligence from the 9th Agency, Moore's secrecy over certain matters, and even her overwhelming technical prowess are all reasons to suspect her.
Even though she's already helped you out so many times, you still can't be sure if she's really trying to help, or... to get close to you and gain your trust?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Speaking of which, Moore.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Yes?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's something I've never quite understood.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've said it yourself. Normal people should be scared of the dark web and fear they won't be so lucky next time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So why do you... insist on investigating it?
Moore's gaze turns somewhat evasive for a moment. You stare at her intently, awaiting her answer.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Yeah... This is indeed not normal.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: The dark web is such a terrifying thing with all these secret powers and conspiracies entangled in it... This mere Cybersec programmer doesn't avoid it and even keeps digging deeper as if she wants those people to find her...
As usual, Moore smiles.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Chief, do you want to know why?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Then... please follow me.

█/█
17:28
Eastside Sunshine Nursing Home
Through the glass window of the ward, you see an elderly person with white hair muttering incessantly with a vacant look.
